description: Export multiple transcriptions at once as a ZIP archive. Server returns ZIP, MCP unpacks it into the specified output_dir. ONE API call regardless of count (1-100 transcriptions per call). Use for bulk operations like "export all meetings from last week" — much faster and cheaper than calling memo_export_transcription 100 times.

output_dir.description: Absolute directory path where files will be saved

name: memo_bulk_export
